text: {"faqs":[{"question":"How do I reset MFA?","answer":"MFA can be reset from the Customer Portal by navigating to Account > Security > Reset MFA. If you are locked out, please contact support to verify your identity using 2 of 3 factors, and a reset link will be sent to you, valid for 24 hours."},{"question":"How do I change the email address on my account?","answer":"You can change your email address by logging into the Customer Portal, going to Account > Profile, and updating your email information."},{"question":"What currencies does Acme Pay support?","answer":"Acme Pay supports transactions in USD, EUR, GBP, and INR."},{"question":"How long are customer application logs kept?","answer":"Customer application logs are retained for 13 months."},{"question":"How long are payment transaction records stored?","answer":"Payment transaction records are stored for a period of 7 years."},{"question":"Does Acme store my full card number?","answer":"No, Acme never stores the full card number; all cards are tokenized by the Payment Gateway."},{"question":"What happens if my session in the Customer Portal expires?","answer":"If your session expires after 15 minutes of inactivity, you will receive an error code CP-401 and will need to log in again."},{"question":"How can I request a refund?","answer":"Refunds can be requested within 30 days of purchase. Once approved, they are issued within 2 business days, though your bank may take an additional 5-10 business days to process."},{"question":"What notifications does Acme Notify send?","answer":"Acme Notify sends both email and SMS notifications to keep you informed about your account."},{"question":"Can I access my transaction history?","answer":"Yes, you can access your transaction history through the Customer Portal under the Account section."},{"question":"What should I do if I forget my password?","answer":"If you forget your password, you can reset it by clicking on the 'Forgot Password?' link on the login page and following the instructions."},{"question":"Is there a mobile app for Acme products?","answer":"Currently, Acme does not offer a dedicated mobile app, but our services are accessible via mobile web browsers."},{"question":"What is the process for changing my account password?","answer":"To change your password, log into the Customer Portal, go to Account > Security, and select 'Change Password'."},{"question":"How can I update my payment method?","answer":"You can update your payment method in the Customer Portal under the Billing section."},{"question":"What should I do if I suspect fraud on my account?","answer":"If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact support immediately to investigate and secure your account."}]}
